target_semantics_lesson: Forecast the acceleration of year-over-year revenue growth, considering automotive pricing, delivery volumes, and energy segment performance.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate the causal bridge by reconciling automotive revenue to volume and pricing, and energy segment growth to total revenue.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Price cuts can weaken revenue growth, but strong deliveries or energy segment growth can offset this. Assess the net effect on the rate of revenue change.
counterevidence_lesson: Delivery volume alone may not guarantee revenue acceleration if price cuts significantly reduce revenue per unit.
calibration_lesson: Weak links, like uncertainty in price-cut impact versus volume gains, should reduce confidence in the growth acceleration forecast.
